messages.content: Who signed the declaration of independence?

function.name: historical_event_get_date
function.description: Retrieve the date of a specific historical event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_name.description: The name of the historical event.

event_location.description: The location of the historical event.

event_time_period.description: The historical time period during which the event took place. (e.g., Renaissance, Middle Ages, etc.)
